subject.title: fix(memory-core): keep same-agent session hits in memory recall under tree visibility (#103732)

question: Should memory recall intentionally treat an unset `tools.sessions.visibility` default as same-agent-wide while an explicitly configured `visibility: "tree"` remains limited to the current session tree, and should plugins receive a public SDK helper for that distinction?
rationale: Both policies can be implemented safely, but choosing different authorization behavior for an implicit and explicit form of the same resolved value changes a security-sensitive compatibility contract and requires owner intent.

options.title: Approve the default-only exception
options.body: Keep the narrow exception and SDK helper, with explicit compatibility coverage and live indexed-recall proof.

options.title: Keep tree semantics uniform
options.body: Require unset and explicit `tree` to behave identically, then introduce a separately documented policy for same-agent memory recall.

recommendation.title: Approve the default-only exception
recommendation.body: Keep the narrow exception and SDK helper, with explicit compatibility coverage and live indexed-recall proof.

likelyOwner.reason: They reviewed and landed the original memory-search visibility security contract and are the strongest available owner for calibrating this exception.
